words.definition: n. 一排，一列；vi. 划船；n. 争吵

examples.en: The chairs were arranged in neat rows facing the stage.
examples.zh: 椅子一排排整齐地面向舞台摆放。

examples.en: The old man rows across the river every morning to sell vegetables.
examples.zh: 老人每天早晨划船过河去卖菜。

words.usage: in a row 成一排；连续，win three times in a row 连赢三次；row v. 划船。熟词僻义：row 读 raʊ 时指争吵（a family row），考研阅读偶现，靠语境辨音。
collocations: in a row 成排；连续
words.mnemonic: 排排坐读 rəʊ；吵架读 raʊ（吼）

words.definition: vt. 发誓；vi. 咒骂，骂人

examples.en: Witnesses must swear an oath before giving testimony in court.
examples.zh: 证人在法庭作证前必须宣誓。

examples.en: He swore to keep the findings confidential until the paper was published.
examples.zh: 他承诺在论文发表前对研究结果保密。

words.usage: swear an oath 宣誓；swear to do 保证做；swear at sb 辱骂某人；swear off sth 保证戒除。不规则变化 swear—swore—sworn。
collocations: swear off sth 保证戒除
words.mnemonic: s+wear(穿戴)→把誓言穿在身上→发誓

words.definition: adj. 年少的；资历浅的；n. 晚辈

examples.en: Junior staff are often excluded from strategic decision-making.
examples.zh: 基层员工常被排除在战略决策之外。

examples.en: He joined the firm two years later than me, so he is junior to me.
examples.zh: 他比我晚两年进公司，所以资历比我浅。

words.usage: junior to sb 比某人年少、资历浅，to 不可省；junior staff 基层员工；junior high school 初中。反义 senior 成对记忆；同词根 juvenile 少年的。
collocations: be junior to sb 资历浅于某人
words.mnemonic: juven(年轻)+ior→更年轻→年少的；资历浅

words.definition: n. 皮革；皮制品；adj. 皮革制的

examples.en: The seats are upholstered in soft Italian leather.
examples.zh: 座椅用柔软的意大利皮革包覆。

examples.en: Demand for leather goods has surged among young consumers.
examples.zh: 年轻消费者对皮具的需求激增。

words.usage: leather goods／shoes 皮具、皮鞋；genuine／faux leather 真皮、人造革；作定语 a leather jacket。派生：leathery adj. 粗糙似革的。
words.mnemonic: 谐音「莱瑟」像皮衣名牌→皮革

words.definition: vt. 排练，预演；vi. 排练

examples.en: The orchestra rehearsed the symphony for weeks before the premiere.
examples.zh: 交响乐团在首演前排练这部交响曲数周。

examples.en: She rehearsed her answers before the job interview.
examples.zh: 求职面试前，她预演了如何作答。

words.usage: rehearse a play／speech 排练戏剧、演讲；引申指面试发言前的预演。派生：rehearsal n. 排练，dress rehearsal 彩排；rehearsed adj. 背熟的，照本宣科的。
collocations: rehearse a play 排练戏剧
rehearse one's lines 练习台词
words.mnemonic: re(反复)+herse(耙)→反复耙一遍→排练

words.definition: adj. 分析的；善于分析的

examples.en: The report offers an analytical framework for assessing economic risk.
examples.zh: 该报告提供了一个评估经济风险的分析框架。

examples.en: Good researchers must be analytical rather than merely intuitive.
examples.zh: 优秀的研究者必须善于分析，而非仅凭直觉。

words.usage: 多作定语修饰 approach、skill、mind 等名词。派生：analysis n. 分析；analyze vt. 分析；analytically adv. 分析地；analyte n. 分析物。
words.mnemonic: analyse（分析）变体 + tical → 分析的；analyte 被分析物

words.definition: adj. 单数的；非凡的；n. 单数

examples.en: The singular form of most English nouns is listed first in dictionaries.
examples.zh: 大多数英语名词的单数形式在词典中排在首位。

examples.en: She showed singular courage in defending her research findings.
examples.zh: 她在捍卫研究成果时表现出非凡的勇气。

words.usage: 语法术语义「单数的」与 plural（复数的）相对；作形容词表「非凡的」多作定语，如 singular achievement。派生：singularity n. 奇点；singularly adv. 异常地。
collocations: third person singular 第三人称单数
words.mnemonic: singul（single 单一）+ ar → 单一的 → 单数的、非凡的

words.definition: n. 雷；雷声；vi. 打雷；轰隆作响

examples.en: We heard the thunder rolling in the distance before the rain arrived.
examples.zh: 雨来之前，我们听见远处雷声滚滚。

examples.en: The train thundered past the quiet countryside station.
examples.zh: 火车轰隆隆地驶过宁静的乡村小站。

words.usage: 名词表雷声不可数；动词义「轰隆作响」，如 thunder at sb。习语 steal one's thunder（抢风头）。派生：thunderstorm n. 雷暴；thunderous adj. 雷鸣般的。

confusables.note: 在下面；只差 th，勿漏字母

collocations: thunder and lightning 雷电交加
a clap of thunder 一声炸雷
steal one's thunder 抢某人风头
words.mnemonic: th + under：雷声在头顶下方滚滚 → 雷；拟声词

words.definition: prep. 关于；至于

examples.en: The committee raised several questions regarding the funding cuts.
examples.zh: 委员会就资金削减提出了几个问题。

examples.en: He said nothing regarding his future plans.
examples.zh: 他对自己的未来计划只字未提。

words.usage: 正式书面介词，多置于名词后引出话题，常见于公函与学术写作。同族：regard vt. 看待；regardless adv. 不管；in regard to 亦表「关于」。

confusables.note: 保卫；词中 guar 与 gard 易混

words.mnemonic: regard（看待）+ ing → 正在看待之事 → 关于

words.definition: vt. 使遭受；施加（打击、伤害）

examples.en: The crisis inflicted heavy losses on small manufacturing firms.
examples.zh: 这场危机给小型制造企业造成了惨重损失。

examples.en: The court held that he had inflicted serious harm on the victim.
examples.zh: 法院认定他对被害人造成了严重伤害。

words.usage: 固定句型 inflict sth on/upon sb（使某人遭受某事），宾语多为 damage、loss、injury 等消极名词。派生：infliction n. 施加。
collocations: inflict damage on 对…造成损害
inflict punishment on 对…施加惩罚
inflict losses on 使…蒙受损失
words.mnemonic: in（进入）+ flict（打）→ 打进去 → 使遭受

words.definition: n. 机制；机械装置

examples.en: Scientists are still studying the mechanism behind climate change.
examples.zh: 科学家仍在研究气候变化背后的机制。

examples.en: The watch contains a delicate mechanism made of tiny gears.
examples.zh: 这块表里有一个由微小齿轮构成的精密装置。

words.usage: 常与 of 连用表「…的机制」，学术阅读高频，如 market mechanism（市场机制）、defense mechanism（防御机制）。派生：mechanic n. 技工；mechanical adj. 机械的。

confusables.note: 机器；词首 mech- 同形

words.mnemonic: mechan（机器）+ ism → 机器运转之理 → 机制

words.definition: vi. 下沉；骤降；n. 水槽

examples.en: The ship sank within twenty minutes after striking the reef.
examples.zh: 轮船撞上礁石后不到二十分钟便沉没了。

examples.en: Household spending sank to its lowest level in five years.
examples.zh: 家庭支出降至五年来的最低水平。

words.usage: 过去式 sank，过去分词 sunk；比喻义可表数字「骤降」或心情「低落」，如 heart sank。短语 sink into（陷入）。名词指厨房水槽。派生：sinking n./adj. 下沉（的）。

confusables.note: 同步；与 sink 同音易混

collocations: sink into despair 陷入绝望
sink to a record low 跌至历史最低
words.mnemonic: 水槽堵了水沉不下去 → sink 下沉；过去式 sank 记牢

words.definition: vt. 放大；增强；详述

examples.en: Social media can amplify public anxiety during a crisis.
examples.zh: 危机期间，社交媒体会放大公众的焦虑。

examples.en: The device amplifies weak electrical signals from the antenna.
examples.zh: 该装置放大天线接收到的微弱电信号。

words.usage: 及物动词，宾语常为 signal、effect、concern 等；媒体语境比喻「放大影响、加剧情绪」。派生：amplifier n. 放大器；amplification n. 放大。
collocations: amplify the signal 放大信号
amplify the effect 增强效果
words.mnemonic: ampl（大，同 ample 充裕）+ ify → 使变大 → 放大

words.definition: n. 惯性；惰性

examples.en: Bureaucratic inertia often delays the implementation of new policies.
examples.zh: 官僚体制的惰性常常拖延新政策的落实。

examples.en: Objects tend to keep moving because of inertia.
examples.zh: 由于惯性，物体往往保持运动状态。

words.usage: 物理义「惯性」不可数；比喻义指组织或个人的「惰性、不作为」，常见搭配 bureaucratic/organizational inertia。派生：inert adj. 惰性的；inertly adv. 无生气地。

confusables.note: 惰性的；同根形容词形近

collocations: law of inertia 惯性定律
words.mnemonic: in（不）+ ert（动）→ 不爱动 → 惯性、惰性

words.definition: adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；n. 未成年人

examples.en: Juvenile crime rates have fallen steadily over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年，青少年犯罪率持续下降。

examples.en: Critics dismissed the film as juvenile humor.
examples.zh: 评论家斥这部电影为幼稚的搞笑。

words.usage: 形容词多作定语，正式语境指「青少年相关的」，如 juvenile court（少年法庭）、juvenile delinquency（少年犯罪）；贬义指「幼稚的」。名词指未成年人。派生：rejuvenate v. 使年轻。
words.mnemonic: juven（年轻）+ ile → 年幼的；June 初夏万物正幼

words.definition: n. 丛林；混乱拥挤之地

examples.en: Large areas of tropical jungle have been cleared for farming.
examples.zh: 大片热带丛林已被开垦为农田。

examples.en: He described the job market as a jungle where only the fittest survive.
examples.zh: 他把就业市场比作适者生存的丛林。

words.usage: 可数名词，本义「热带丛林」，常与 tropical、dense 搭配；习语 the law of the jungle（丛林法则）常见于评论文章。派生：jungly adj. 丛林密布的。
collocations: the law of the jungle 丛林法则
words.mnemonic: 音「壮苟」：藤壮枝密、生存苟艰 → 丛林

words.definition: n. 传单；小册子；vt. 散发传单

examples.en: Volunteers handed out leaflets to publicize the charity concert.
examples.zh: 志愿者分发传单为慈善音乐会做宣传。

examples.en: Environmental groups leafleted the neighborhood against the new road.
examples.zh: 环保团体在街区散发传单，反对修建新路。

words.usage: 名词可数，指单页或折页宣传品；动词义「散发传单」较正式，如 leaflet the area。同义 pamphlet、brochure 可换用。派生：leafleteer n. 发传单者。
collocations: an information leaflet 信息传单
leaflet campaign 传单宣传运动
words.mnemonic: leaf（叶）+ let（小）→ 薄如叶片的纸 → 传单

words.definition: adj. 真诚的；诚挚的

examples.en: Please accept my sincere apologies for the delayed reply.
examples.zh: 回复迟了，请接受我诚挚的歉意。

examples.en: She expressed sincere gratitude to her supervisor.
examples.zh: 她向导师表达了真诚的感谢。

words.usage: 多作定语修饰 apology、thanks、belief 等名词；信函落款 Yours sincerely 注意副词拼写。派生：sincerity n. 真诚；sincerely adv. 真诚地。

confusables.note: 风景；字母重排形近易混

collocations: a sincere friend 真诚的朋友
words.mnemonic: sin（罪）+ cere → 忏悔献谷、心无杂念 → 真诚

words.definition: n. 结；节（航速单位）；v. 打结

examples.en: Tie the rope in a tight knot so it will not come loose.
examples.zh: 把绳子打一个紧结，这样就不会松开。

examples.en: The ship was cruising at thirty knots.
examples.zh: 那艘船以三十节的速度巡航。

words.usage: 名词本义「绳结」，引申「疙瘩、难题」；习语 tie the knot（结婚）高频；航速单位「节」等于每小时一海里。动词义「打结；（眉）皱起」。派生：knotted adj. 缠结的。

confusables.note: 球形把手；kn- 默音同族

collocations: a knot in one's stomach 心里发紧
words.mnemonic: k 不发音同 know；绳上打个 not（不松）结 → 结

words.definition: vi. 倚靠；倾斜；adj. 瘦的；精简的

examples.en: Many firms are adopting lean management to cut waste.
examples.zh: 许多公司正采用精益管理来减少浪费。

examples.en: She leaned against the doorframe, watching the rain.
examples.zh: 她倚着门框，看着雨。

words.usage: 短语 lean on/against（倚靠）、lean towards（倾向于）；形容词义「精简高效的」，如 lean management（精益管理）；经济语境 lean years 表不景气。

confusables.note: 学习；lean 少了 r 易混
干净的；lean 多了 c 易混

words.mnemonic: lean 少个 r 就不是 learn——身歪字更歪 → 倾斜
